descriptionChirho: To feel envy or resentment toward another person on account of their advantages, possessions, or status (Piel; Arabic حسد ḥasada, Korean 시기, Swahili -husudu/-onea wivu).

To burn with possessive jealousy or passionate zeal, whether of God for his people, a husband for his wife, or a person zealous for a cause (Piel; Arabic غار ghāra, Korean 질투/열심, Swahili -wiwa na wivu / bidii).
To cause someone to become jealous or envious, a causative action making another feel the sting of jealousy (Hifil causative stem; Arabic أغار aghāra, Korean 질투하게 하다).
